text: With `--max-query-len`, bytes past the cap are don't-care, so any order of suffixes equal under the cap is a correct sort. At c69cc0a, `find_lcp` (`libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs`) compared `max_query_len` bytes after `skip`, past the cap, so those ties changed order with `-t` and `-n` (chr1, `-m 16`: three files, no out-of-order key). 9984777 caps it at `max_query_len - skip`. Partitioning reads an uncapped 5-character DNA prefix, so under a shorter cap, partitions split such ties by bytes past it.
